raw_response:
I am 63 years old and I have farmed this 3 mu of land for 45 years. I only went to primary school, but I know my fields better than any book. My son works in a factory in town, so it is just me and my husband working the land now. We grow wheat in winter and maize in summer on the same 3 mu — that is what everyone in Quzhou does.

For winter wheat: Last year I used one full bag of compound fertilizer per mu as base dressing — that is 50 kg per mu. This year I will do exactly the same. The dealer sells it in 50 kg bags, and I need 3 bags for my whole field. At green-up time in late March, I will spread half a bag of urea per mu, which is 25 kg per mu. I bought 2 bags of urea last year and had a little left, so I will buy 2 bags again this year. I know the urea costs me about 100 yuan per bag, but if I use less, the wheat turns yellow and I lose more money at harvest. I will irrigate three times from my well: first in late November before the ground freezes, second in early April when the wheat starts jointing, and third in early May when the grain is filling. Each time I run the pump for about 4 hours. I spray herbicide once in March when the weeds are small, and if I see bugs or white spots on the leaves, I spray one more time. I hire the rotary tiller from the village machine owner to till once before I sow in early October. I expect about 900 jin per mu, which is 450 kg per mu.

For summer maize: Right after I cut the wheat in early June, I plant hybrid maize seed. I buy 3 small bags — about 2.5 kg per mu, so 7.5 kg total for 3 mu. I drill the seed directly without plowing because there is no time, and my neighbor Zhang does it this way and his maize does fine. At planting, I put 40 kg of compound fertilizer per mu, so I need about two and a half 50-kg bags for the 3 mu. When the maize is at big trumpet stage, about knee-high, I spread 25 kg of urea per mu — another bag and a half. I irrigate twice: once right after sowing if the soil is dry, and once at big trumpet stage. I spray herbicide once after the seedlings come up, and once if I see worms eating the leaves. Last year I got about 1000 jin per mu, so I expect 500 kg per mu this year if the weather holds.

I think carefully about every yuan. Compound fertilizer is about 150 yuan per 50 kg bag, urea is about 100 yuan. For wheat I spend about 450 yuan on fertilizer, and for maize about 375 yuan. That is a lot for a small farm, but I learned 20 years ago that cutting fertilizer to save money gives me an empty grain basket in autumn.
